The '''Kilran's Lance''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten Ten]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that was operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Traitors aboard the station disabled the station's defenses, allowing the Republic to launch a [[Battle of Aeten II|surprise attack]] that was nonetheless beaten back by the Empire.
